comment: Quality is unbelievable. The fabric feels authentic and the crest embroidery is spot on. Delivery to Nakawa was quick too.
My boyfriend loved the Real Madrid jersey. Got it with Bellingham 5 printed. Member pricing saved me UGX 10,000!
Argentina champions edition! Worth every shilling. The 3-star crest detail is incredible. Best jersey in my collection.
Man City jersey arrived in great condition. Only issue: the sizing runs a bit slim. Would recommend sizing up.
Barça stripes are vibrant and the fabric breathes well during matches. WhatsApp ordering was so smooth for us in Uganda.
YNWA! Liverpool jersey fits perfectly. Got Salah 11 customized and it looks professional. Free delivery to Makerere 👏
Brazil jersey color is rich. Packaging was nice with the Darro branding. Took 4 days to get to Mbarara which is fine.
Arsenal jersey came with all the right details - sponsor, league patch, everything. Low stock warning was real, glad I ordered!
Newcastle stripes are crisp. Fabric feels premium. Minor delay on delivery but Darro team communicated well throughout.
